pageDescription: To trigger an operation such as actions in forms, dialogs and more

anatomyImage.alt: Button anatomy diagram showing container, label, and icon callouts
anatomyImage.caption:
1. Container - Defines hit area, background, border, and corner radius.
2. Label - Action text using base text style (Inter, 16px / 24px line height on medium size).
3. Icon - Font Awesome glyph aligned to the label; icon-only buttons omit the label.

usage.guidelineRichText:
- Buttons should be clear and predictable - users should be able to anticipate what will happen when the button is selected.
- Use active verbs or phrases that encourage action, such as Continue, Save, Submit.
- Button labels should be in sentence case. When a button label contains an established business term, product name, process name, or acronym, preserve the capitalisation used by the business or product, even if this results in title-case styling.
usage.usageRichText:
- **Primary:** Primary button is intended to be used for leading actions, and should be use sparingly.
- **Secondary:** Secondary button is an alternative to the primary action, and are given less visual emphasis.
- **Tertiary:** Tertiary button is used as lower priority optional actions.
- **With Helper Icon:** Buttons with helper icon provide additional context or guidance, where helpful.
- **Link:** Text link is used for navigation or secondary actions within the interface.
- **Icon button:** Text button and icon buttons are used for miscellaneous actions, and are given the least visual emphasis.

contextBySize.base: Base (size) are for primary actions on edit drawers, modals, forms and edit page headers.
contextBySize.small: Small (size) are for primary actions on edit drawers, modals, forms and edit page headers.
contextBySize.x-small: X-Small (size) are for primary actions on edit drawers, modals, forms and edit page headers.

variantShowcases.title: Secondary Button
variantShowcases.description: Used for supporting actions that are important to the user but are not the primary action in a given context. They are used as an alternative and to give the primary action more emphasis. They are also associated with negative actions such as Cancel and Delete.

contextBySize.base: Base (size) are for secondary actions on edit drawers, accordions, modals and edit page headers and global filters.
contextBySize.small: Small (size) are for secondary actions on edit drawers, accordions, modals and edit page headers and global filters.
contextBySize.x-small: X-Small (size) are for secondary actions on edit drawers, accordions, modals and edit page headers and global filters.

variantShowcases.title: Tertiary Button
variantShowcases.description: Tertiary buttons are used as a lower priority and/or optional action and they given less visual emphasis than primary and secondary buttons.

contextBySize.base: Base (size) are used for optional actions in a data table and edit drawers.
contextBySize.x-small: X-Small (size) are used for optional actions in a data table and edit drawers.
